text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: difference in mean quantile score (points of capacity) over the five decision substations, leads 0.5 to 168 hours, outside switching events. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Dashed line: no difference. Below zero favours the first arm. All five contrasts are planned. The known-answer gate failed, so none carries a label.'
text.tspan: Dot: difference in mean quantile score (points of capacity) over the five decision substations,
leads 0.5 to 168 hours, outside switching events. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole
calendar months. Dashed line: no difference. Below zero favours the first arm. All five
contrasts are planned. The known-answer gate failed, so none carries a label.
